title: Partition Array to Minimize XOR
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, partition nums into k non-empty subarrays.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, partition nums into k non-empty subarrays. Compute the bitwise XOR for each subarray. Minimize the maximum XOR value among these subarrays.
constraints: Split into exactly k nonempty contiguous subarrays.
hints: Prefix XOR evaluates a segment in constant time.
Use DP by prefix length and group count.
Try every final cut and minimize the resulting maximum.
Every partition has exactly one final cut considered by the recurrence.
editorial: Every partition has exactly one final cut considered by the recurrence.

tests.explanation: The split [1] and [2,3] has maximum XOR one.
The split [2], [3,3], [2] has maximum XOR two.
